📊 The 2026 local elections in under a minute.

ANC down to 30.8%, DA up to 24.6%, MK at 9.8% in its first local election. Turnout rose to 52%. And the biggest number of all: 137 of 213 councils are hung.

Only Cape Town has a metro majority. Everywhere else, coalition deals will set your rates, water and electricity tariffs from July 2027.

Source: IEC declaration, 8 November 2026. Education, not financial advice.
